reason: Preserve the original interface, with explicitly requested native integrations, reusable Explorer picker, remembered tabs, bundled settings icon, safe notification deduplication and AI-generated lotus wallpapers (formerly Bloom). The HTML taskbar, Start, desktop and their flyouts are removed: the native GTK 4 shell replaces them (html_shell_removed).
cross_origin_tab_transfer: The tab-transfer module also writes a marked versioned text/plain ticket envelope, because WebKit restricts custom MIME data to one origin and native hosts use independent localhost origins. Only validated tab envelopes are consumed.
native_tab_detach: The tab-transfer module records native drag begin/end and uses compositor containment after a no-target drag because WebKitGTK retains local coordinates. The Rust host distinguishes generic Wayland errors using a matching compositor end snapshot; explicit cancellation still preserves the source.

clipboard_ordering.reason: One shared clipboard revision watermark rejects stale HTTP Get/Set replies and queued SSE events; legacy/mock unversioned state remains supported before Rust revision state is observed. Failed Get calls preserve newer state.

alles_progress.reason: Keep the original index-progress and welcome DOM and ongoing status-ring animation during status refresh; update only current values and reserve the existing one-line path height. CSS and static populated layout remain unchanged.

alles_index_lifecycle: De Rust-versie meldt dat de indexer bij sluiten van Alles stopt en bij opnieuw openen verdergaat. De referentieversie behoudt haar bestaande achtergrondtekst.
settings_icon: Op verzoek wordt het gekleurde Win11-icon-theme-instellingenpictogram als vaste vector gebruikt; de bijbehorende COPYING/AUTHORS/NOTICE worden meegeleverd.
native_picker: Openen, Opslaan als en map kiezen gebruiken de bestaande Verkenner-interface in een modaal Rust-venster; selectie, annuleren en overschrijfbevestiging zijn in echte GNOME gecontroleerd.
file_type_defaults: Een afzonderlijke Standaardapps-app gebruikt de bestaande Fluent-componenten en nieuwe Rust-API’s voor precies één MIME-type per wijziging.
window_session: Verkenner bewaart semantische tabstatus via Rust; expliciete paden, taboverdracht en bestandskiezers behouden hun gerichte start.
notification_deduplication: GNOME-meldingen worden aan één actieve renderer overgedragen; vervanging behoudt één pop-up en één item. Stil geachte GNOME-meldingen krijgen geen tweede pop-up.
native_explorer_paint: De native detailweergave houdt rij-inhoud tekenbaar wanneer rijen na scrollen opnieuw zichtbaar zijn.
menu_focus: De menucontainer behoudt zijn gewone schaduw als hij toetsenbordfocus heeft; er verschijnt geen aparte buitencontour.
lotus_wallpapers: Op verzoek zijn de twee Bloei-achtergronden vervangen door aangeleverde, met AI gemaakte PNG’s (OpenAI ChatGPT-beeldgeneratie, CC0-1.0, zie assets/wallpapers/SOURCES.json). De originele PNG-bytes zijn ingebed in lotus-dark.svg en lotus-light.svg; de oude ingebouwde namen builtin:bloom-dark en builtin:bloom-light verwijzen nog naar deze bestanden en licht/donker-koppeling blijft werken.
removed_assets: Verwijderd voor publicatie: de oude schermafbeeldingen assets/img/screenshots/*.jpg (met een Windows-achtig startlogo) en het ongebruikte assets/img/lockscreen.jpg van onbekende herkomst. Geen code gebruikte ze.
mock_icons: De nep-app-iconen voor andere browsers en softwarecentra in js/mock/index.js zijn neutraal: een wereldbol en een boodschappentas in plaats van productlogo’s.
interimNative: Native runtime with GNOME energy profiles, screen timeout and AC/battery sleep controls in the existing Settings interface; all previous native features retained.

english_option.reason: English as a live option next to the Dutch default (GE1a, notes/claude/round1/ge1a.md): H's E0a/E1 UI work merged split-free (core/i18n.js countOf/list/collator/i18nReport, cached Intl, bridge texts and error key/params, collation, plural objects, state kept over the language reload, the notification label for an empty app name), Codex's Dutch-only texts moved into dictionaries, GNOME-correct clipboard, display and night-light texts (D-G2), Start relabelled after a live switch (also while hidden), the window chrome (caption buttons, Back, the navigation toggle, search and clear buttons, the navigation tree name) and the taskbar/desktop names relabelled after a live switch (GE1a fix round, review M1), the English Power group heading, en polish, Wi-Fi password prompt on host codes only (C2), and Task Manager's Always-on-top switch disabled with a GNOME-correct description (D-G2). No CSS, HTML or asset changed; Dutch output is byte-identical except tests/i18n/BASELINE-CHANGES.ui.

ui_text_dump_mocks.reason: Test scaffolding only (D-G17, GE0a, tests/i18n/MOCK-CHANGES.md): mocks for the 18 host methods G's UI added and a console warning for an unknown mock method. The bridge loads mock/ only with ?mock=1 or without a host token; the Rust host always passes a token.

windows_update.reason: Windows Update (notes/claude/windows-update-gnome.md §3, step GW3): the Update page becomes Windows 11 24H2 Windows Update on the update.* service (hero states, update rows, restart banners, Meer opties with the subpages Updategeschiedenis and Geavanceerde opties; CSS only in the update block of settings.css). update-release.js, update-history.js and update-advanced.js are stubs with their final exports (GW4, GW6). mock/update.js is test scaffolding (D-G17): every page state for the text dump and the screenshots (?updateScenario=); mock/settings.js and mock/system.js gain the update defaults and system.updates.rebootRequired.

round3_english_review.reason: Round 3 R3-UI (notes/claude/round3/r3-ui.md): the English review of every UI text (Windows 11 24H2 en-GB wording, contractions, Recycle Bin and Flight mode per tools/i18n/glossary.tsv, plural-aware '1 file, 1 folder'), the en-only width of the display dropdowns, the language dropdown shown as contracts C1 reads the setting, Start tiles reloaded at once on a language switch, preview/wm.js 'Alles' (D-G5), Windows Update A2 leftovers (held Snap refreshes, 'Aanvullende opties', the restart-row description, Updategeschiedenis' related settings, the restart-all button kept disabled), and the mocks: invalid_value for a language (D-G31), key/params on thrown errors (D-G41), mock texts in the UI language. Dutch: only D-G44's new keys. Fix round (r3-ui-review.md): one English rendering per Dutch text (Taakbeheer's system process, Windows' Title Case file type names in Alles and Verkenner, the Empty Recycle Bin message), Dutch-ordered English rewritten, the Recovery deep link is a one-shot param, mock errors keep C2's data, ?mockRestartAll=live.

html_shell_removed.reason: Robin 2026-11-13 (“ik wil de GTK4 versie op github hebben, verwijder de GTK3 variant”, D-G70): the native GTK 4 shell (native/shell, win11-shell) is the only shell, so the HTML shell surfaces are removed: js/shell/ (taskbar, Start, search, quick settings, notifications and calendar, tray, Win+X, task view, clipboard, power, OSD, toasts), js/desktop/, js/preview/wm.js, js/gallery.js, js/core/flyouts.js and css/shell.css, flyouts.css, desktop.css, preview.css and gallery.css. No app imported them. main.js serves only surface=app (any other surface gets the unknown-view placeholder); native-backdrop.css keeps only the app-window Mica rules. The HTML apps (Verkenner, Instellingen, Taakbeheer, Alles, Schijven, Standaard-apps, Installatieprogramma), core/* and assets/ stay. Earlier entries for the removed files (taskbar centring, Start recommendations and corners, Start logo, desktop language, search, taskbar input, calendar day click) went with them; the native shell carries their behaviour.
